title: The Last Lantern
summary: Explore Hearthmere and the surrounding wilderness in a single-hero fantasy adventure.
controls: Move with arrow keys or WASD and use the game’s Interact and menu controls. Touch controls are provided by the game.
limitations: The game is visual. Saves are local to the browser; local-play progress does not automatically transfer to the public site.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: Rowan among timber cottages and trees in Hearthmere.
